critical_code_review_comments: BUG: proxy.ts section 5 (auth routes) discards affiliate_ref cookie — creates new NextResponse (res) instead of returning original `response` that has the cookie. Fix: `return response;` with headers set on `response`.

DEAD CODE: proxy.ts section 9 (lines 366-372 'Redirect authenticated users away from auth pages') can NEVER be reached for auth routes because section 5 returns early. Section 9's isAuthRoute check will always be false by the time the code reaches it. This means authenticated users visiting /auth/signin will see the signin page (not be redirected). This is NOT a regression but is confusing dead code.

rca_of_the_issue: FIX-02 RCA: proxy.ts cookie loss for auth routes. Line 234: `const response = NextResponse.next(...)`. Lines 241-249: `response.cookies.set('affiliate_ref', refCode, ...)`. Lines 287-297 (section 5): `const res = NextResponse.next(...); return res;` — new response without the affiliate_ref cookie. Fix: replace `const res = NextResponse.next(...)` with using `response` directly and set headers on `response`. Affected routes: /auth/signin, /auth/signup, /auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password, /auth/verify-email. Public routes correctly set the cookie (section 4 returns `response`).
